findings: The badge loop is half switched off: 46.1% of live booking pages show it because it is off by default on Growth and Business, while 92.0% of Starter pages keep it on.
Badge traffic hides in Unassigned: utm_medium=powered-by is not a medium GA4 maps to Referral, so 3090 sessions and 87 sign-ups a month look like unexplained traffic.
Blended paid payback (9.2 months) passes the 12-month limit only because Google non-brand search (6.3 months) carries Meta (16.3 months).
Staff invites are not an acquisition loop: 96.5% of accepted invites add a seat, and they bring 31 new accounts a month (k = 0.019).
Content has the second-largest 12-month gain (632) but nothing inside 90 days, because articles take a median 97 days to ramp: start it now alongside the badge.
unknowns: Cycle times are the user's medians from the product database: BigQuery is not connected, so the GA4 export query was not run.
Paying share by channel: every channel uses the overall 18.0%, so channel paybacks are estimates.
Search Console clicks and GA4 sign-ups for templates come from windows 2 days apart, so sign-ups per click is approximate.
